solutions.title: Bitmask with set dedupe
solutions.strategy: Generate every index subset and store sorted value rows in a set.

timeComplexity.explanation: All masks are inspected and each row can cost linear time to copy.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The dedupe set can store every unique subset.

solutions.title: Sorted backtracking skip
solutions.strategy: Sort first, then skip equal values already considered at the same depth.

timeComplexity.explanation: `a` unique subsets are emitted and copied.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Ignoring output, the path and recursion stack are linear.
